company.name: Neo Mobility
company.shortDescription: Neo Mobility is a sustainable mobility solutions provider that specialises in electric vehicle (EV) infrastructure and mobility services.
company.description: Neo Mobility is a MENA-focused electric mobility startup headquartered in Dubai, UAE, specializing in sustainable transportation and EV infrastructure solutions. Founded in 2023, the company offers a fully integrated EV-as-a-Service (EVaaS) platform that combines electric vehicle fleets, charging infrastructure, battery-swapping technology, fleet management software, and driver support services for logistics, e-commerce, food delivery, and taxi mobility businesses. Neo Mobility focuses on decarbonizing first-mile and last-mile transportation by helping businesses transition from traditional fuel-powered fleets to electric mobility systems. Its services include electric delivery fleets, corporate and hospitality EV taxi solutions, fast DC charging networks, telematics and fleet management platforms, and driver safety technologies such as patented airbag vests. The company also operates battery-swapping infrastructure that enables electric bike riders to swap batteries in under 60 seconds, reducing downtime and improving operational efficiency.
